defects_and_limits.finding: Three numerical constraints are almost saturated
defects_and_limits.meaning: Not evidence of current invalidity; naive coefficient/angle edits have almost no remaining error budget, and fixed-word lambda polishing has diminishing returns.

defects_and_limits.finding: Reducing ANGLE scratch alone does not reduce the charged Q_total
defects_and_limits.evidence: ANGLE temporary=75, while inner-state-preparation temporary=304 sets max; current single ANGLE=126 qubits against cap128
defects_and_limits.meaning: Scratch optimization is useful when it enables lower-Toffoli loaders under the 128Q cap, not as a direct score win.

defects_and_limits.finding: Official heuristic selects QROAM block for Toffoli and then a beta*(N-1) workspace threshold, not global T*Q
defects_and_limits.evidence: brot8->9 changes implied inner QROAM k4->5, total Q430->738; holding loader T and lambda fixed gives cost x1.577423588652604
defects_and_limits.meaning: Increasing precision is expensive here. Model settings are fixed by the verifier and cannot be overridden by a submitted state-preparation implementation.

defects_and_limits.finding: Batch size and angle precision are coupled to learned Boolean structure
defects_and_limits.evidence: At J5, bit0 of delta words is affine in low4 address bits for every complete block in loaders4..14; bit1 is also affine for loaders5,7,9,11,13. J4 changes post-first-loader bit0 affine fraction from78.609% to0.201%, J6 to0.219%.
defects_and_limits.meaning: Changing J or unconstrained angle words usually destroys existing synthesis advantages. ANF counts are a structural proxy, not proof of a Toffoli bound.

prioritized_directions.direction: Co-optimize fixed-word ANGLE synthesis, shared Boolean terms and scratch allocation at J5
prioritized_directions.reason: ANGLE execution is51.248% of total T; first four loaders cost301 Toffoli/pass, later loaders279 or258; 2 spare physical qubits under cap
prioritized_directions.minimal_falsifiable_experiment: Choose one301-Toffoli loader and preserve its complete XOR truth table. Synthesize shared nonlinear terms / measurement cleanup under128Q, compare actual executed Toffolis on all1220 addresses and both pass states. Only if improved, verify all64shots per address.
prioritized_directions.payoff_condition: 10% lower total ANGLE T at unchanged Q/lambda yields chemistry cost -5.1248%, overall score x1.0176906; this is a scenario, not achieved.

prioritized_directions.direction: Exact B-axis/address permutation coupled to loader re-synthesis
prioritized_directions.reason: Simultaneously permuting decoded two-body vector rows and the W B-axis within each rho preserves X, native offsets, lambda and both errors in exact arithmetic. This avoids consuming the nearly exhausted numerical error budget. H2_I and offset_W may remain unchanged.
prioritized_directions.minimal_falsifiable_experiment: Permute the eight complete globally16-address-aligned blocks within each rho, leaving its15boundary rows fixed, to preserve low4bit affine structure. Seek improved sharing across high-address blocks, synthesize one full loader family, and require fewer actual Toffolis with every loader<=128Q. A block-internal affine permutation also preserves the affine subspace.
prioritized_directions.evidence: Deterministic block reversal measured max|delta X|=4.440892098500626e-16, max native-offset change=1.7763568394002505e-15, lambda_H2 difference=0.0; these are floating-point summation differences.
prioritized_directions.limitations: A permutation changes the actual required lookup table. Updating npz angle_words alone has no score effect; circuits must be regenerated. Low4bit ANF term counts stay invariant under this restricted block permutation and cannot predict a gate-count win.

prioritized_directions.direction: Quantization-aware factorization with explicit low-bit affine constraints matched to the loader design
prioritized_directions.reason: Current tables encode arithmetic structure; unconstrained lower-error tables can become more expensive circuits. Target the four costly unstructured early loaders or extend second-bit affine relations.
prioritized_directions.minimal_falsifiable_experiment: Fix J5/brot8 and most table words; introduce one blockwise affine bit constraint, refit W/H2_I using decoded words and exact official metrics; compare feasible error margins, lambda and an actually synthesized loader. Reject when physical error or total lambda*T*Q worsens.
prioritized_directions.payoff_condition: No promised numeric gain; use actual encoded words, not only unquantized U, as the optimizer objective.

prioritized_directions.direction: Small structured shape search around cost plateaus, not monotonic size reduction
prioritized_directions.reason: C56 hypothetical cost ratio0.9784766 and C48 ratio0.9347825 if lambda/loader T held fixed, but upstream v15 reports error2=20.44/23.86mHa for those shapes. B143 is at a cheap block boundary; B144 adds482T; B128 triggersQ701 and cost x1.46196 under same assumptions.
prioritized_directions.minimal_falsifiable_experiment: First compare C59/60 with structure-preserving warm starts and beta8; require error1/error2<=20mHa and E_gap>floor, then measure regenerated loaders. Do not count merely smaller tensor dimensions as success.
prioritized_directions.payoff_condition: Hypothetical cost tables assume unchanged lambda and loader T and do not establish feasible candidates.

prioritized_directions.direction: Only change global J after a circuit-level break-even check
prioritized_directions.reason: Every loader must declare identical selection and word registers, so per-loader different J is invalid. J4 Q422 tolerates angle T<=8644.36 (+3.70%); J6 Q438 needs angle T<=8038.90 (-3.56%); J10 Q470 needs <=6951.66 (-16.61%).
prioritized_directions.minimal_falsifiable_experiment: Generate one complete family for an exact same angle table at J4 or structure-preserving J10; retain it only if actual full-family T beats its break-even budget and every circuit <=128Q.
prioritized_directions.payoff_condition: Existing J5 affine structure means these cost-only opportunities may be eliminated by synthesis overhead.

ruled_out_in_this_scope.C_zero_padding: Exact same Hamiltonian/loaded vectors/circuits when added W and H2_I entries are zero. C=60..512 yielded no lower cost thanC60.
ruled_out_in_this_scope.B_R_zero_padding: B=143..1024 and R=8..64 yielded no lower heuristic TQ even optimistically holding loader T fixed. These transforms additionally need new/reindexed address support. One-axis scan only; not a global impossibility proof.
ruled_out_in_this_scope.fixed_shift_tuning: Submitted H1_I/Hsym_lower are replaced by official fixed shifts. KEEP_BITS=10 is fixed. Changing these is not an optimization variable.
